final: SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS atom_count FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (SELECT MAX(atom_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count FROM atom AS a JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' GROUP BY m.molecule_id)) ORDER BY m.molecule_id
